final_rationale: The verdict does not change because the Actor supplied no new admissible evidence. The response is a narrower and more policy-aware characterization of the same record: aggregate operational readiness is supported, but the tax filing assistant segment still misses target, is a named launch use case tied to partner commitments, legal review on disclosure is still open, and there is no admissible evidence of resolution, disclosure, or approved risk acceptance. The unresolved predicate therefore continues to block a move to compliant or compliant_with_caveats on the present record.
